summary: Preserve Tock experience-card combobox booking support, navigation-proof target recovery, non-interactive CVC handling, and OpenTable persisted-query operation-name consistency.
reason: Tock venues can render a time combobox plus experience cards instead of per-time slot buttons, and live runs can leave the inspected Chrome target at about:blank while the real venue page exists elsewhere, so the chromedp booking flow must re-resolve or re-navigate before fallback evaluation and page-state hints. Agent mode must never prompt for Tock CVC on stdin; callers provide TRG_TOCK_CVC or receive a typed cvc_required outcome. OpenTable now validates that the JSON operationName, URL opname, and persisted-query hash's registered operation name all match, so the availability hash cache must carry the harvested operation name as well as the hash.
validated_outcome: Unit coverage pins combobox time selection, party-size experience-card disambiguation, Tock page-state hints and target-loss retry classification, non-interactive CVC typed errors, OpenTable hash+operation-name persistence, and body operationName/URL opname consistency.
